Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 삼단봉이 찌그러졌다. 본인은 맨손으로도 싸울 수 있다고 하는데, 괜찮을까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s baton is bent, but she claims she can just fight barehanded. Should I let her?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の三段棒がへこんだ。本人は素手でも戦えると言っているが、大丈夫だろうか？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的甩棍弯掉了，但她说自己空手也能战斗。没问题吗？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的甩棍彎掉了，但她說自己空手也能戰鬥。沒問題嗎？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Le bâton de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> est tordu, mais elle prétend pouvoir se battre à mains nues. Dois-je la laisser faire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Der Schlagstock von <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ist verbogen, aber sie behauptet, sie könne auch mit bloßen Händen kämpfen. Soll ich sie lassen?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El bastón de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se abolló. Dice que puede luchar con las manos desnudas, ¿estará bien?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A cassetete retrátil de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> amassa. Ele diz que pode lutar com as mãos nuas, será que ele ficará bem?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> กระบองสามท่อนของเธอหักงอ แต่เธอบอกว่าสามารถสู้มือเปล่าได้ จะไหวไหมครับ/คะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tongkat teleskopiknya penyok. Dia bilang dia bisa bertarung dengan tangan kosong, apakah dia baik-baik saja?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Cây dùi cui ba khúc của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã bị móp. Anh ấy nói có thể chiến đấu bằng tay không, liệu có ổn không?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> की लाठी मुड़ गई है, लेकिन वह कहती है कि वह नंगे हाथों से भी लड़ सकती है। क्या मुझे उसे ऐसा करने देना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Maybe we should try a different one later.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 別のトレーニングを考えよう
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Essayons un autre entraînement plus tard.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Lass uns ein anderes Training überlegen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Quizás deberíamos probar otro entrenamiento más tarde.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ลองคิดถึงการฝึกแบบอื่นดูไหมครับ/คะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Mungkin kita coba latihan lain nanti.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Hãy nghĩ đến một bài tập khác.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: शायद हमें बाद में कोई और प्रशिक्षण आज़माना चाहिए।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: All right, let's give it our all!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Très bien, donnons tout ce que nous avons !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ดีเลยครับ/ค่ะ ไปลุยกันอย่างเต็มที่เลย!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Baiklah, mari kita lakukan dengan semangat!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Được thôi, hãy dốc hết sức mình!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: ठीक है, चलो अपना पूरा जोर लगाते हैं!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Une Potion de Vitalité a été remise.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มอบยาเพิ่มพลังให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa một lọ Thuốc Sinh Lực.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé de se reposer après l'entraînement.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, sich nach dem Training auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจพักผ่อนหลังจากการฝึกซ้อม
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi sau khi hoàn thành huấn luyện.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschloss, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังรู้สึกว่ายังไม่พอ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé l'entraînement et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y obtuvo resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e obteve resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองฝึกอีกครั้งและได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi dan mencapai hasil yang solid.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại và đạt được kết quả tốt.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम प्राप्त किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé l'entraînement mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber wieder.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองฝึกอีกครั้งแต่ก็ล้มเหลวอีก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại nhưng lại thất bại.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayée après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดีใจที่ได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hơn sau khi nhận được thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
